dataset.split_policy: normalized-text SHA256 first 8 hex modulo 5: 0=evaluation; others=reference
dataset.retrieval: SQLite FTS5 / BM25, reference rows only, exact normalized query excluded

selection: First N unique evaluation texts sorted by normalized text SHA256; no topic filtering

cases.text: <id> change out cracked pipe on valve bank
<id> - change out right hand engine air conditioner compressor PO
rear door limit switches to be modified
<id> crack in lower centre of windscreen

scope: Five top-level entity types and exact token spans; no fine-grained classes or relation extraction; not a reproduction of the MaintIE paper

metrics.scoring: Exact (start,end,top-level type) set matching; zero denominator -> 0; failed calls -> empty prediction
